scope.summary: Static review of the fictional booking API, web client, deployment configuration, and selected repository history.

coverage.method: Enumerated every FastAPI route registration and traced its authorization dependency.
Reviewed recent commits and credential-like filenames without executing repository code.
exclusions: History older than the synthetic twelve-commit sample was unavailable.

coverage.method: Traced representative booking and profile inputs from React components to API calls.
exclusions: Four presentation-only inputs were not traced beyond local state.

categories.name: Tenant isolation
categories.summary: All booking routes were checked for organization scoping.

categories.name: Secure configuration
categories.summary: Defaults and deployment environment handling were reviewed.

categories.name: Input validation
categories.summary: Representative API input schemas and query construction were traced.

categories.name: Secrets and repository history
categories.summary: Only the provided recent synthetic history was available.

categories.name: Mobile application security
categories.summary: No mobile application code or package was present in scope.

findings.title: Booking lookup does not filter by organization
findings.description: A booking is fetched by public identifier without applying the authenticated organization scope.
preconditions: An authenticated user knows another booking identifier.
findings.exploit_path: GET /bookings/{id} passes the route identifier to an unscoped repository lookup.
findings.impact: A user can read booking details belonging to another organization.
findings.remediation: Filter by both booking id and the authenticated organization id.

findings.title: Booking updates trust organization from the request body
findings.description: The update flow forwards a caller-controlled organization identifier to persistence.
preconditions: An authenticated user can update a booking they can reference.
findings.exploit_path: PATCH /bookings/{id} accepts organization_id and forwards the complete payload.
findings.impact: A user can attempt to move or overwrite a booking across organization boundaries.
findings.remediation: Derive organization scope from the authenticated principal and reject scope fields in the payload.
acceptance_criteria: Organization scope is never accepted from the request body.

findings.title: Debug mode defaults to enabled
findings.description: The application enables debug behavior when the environment variable is absent.
preconditions: A deployment omits the DEBUG environment variable.
findings.exploit_path: The default configuration exposes verbose error behavior in an otherwise valid deployment.
findings.impact: Verbose errors can disclose internal implementation details.
findings.remediation: Use a fail-closed false default and enable debug mode only in explicit development profiles.
acceptance_criteria: DEBUG is false when the environment variable is absent.
Production startup rejects an explicit true value.

findings.title: Parameterized filters prevent SQL text concatenation
findings.description: The reviewed search path builds filters with SQLAlchemy expressions rather than SQL strings.
preconditions: A caller supplies a booking search term.
findings.exploit_path: No injection path was verified for the reviewed query.
findings.impact: This control reduces SQL injection risk on the reviewed surface.
findings.remediation: Preserve expression-based parameter binding when adding filters.
acceptance_criteria: New booking filters continue to use bound SQLAlchemy expressions.

strengths.title: JWT signatures and expiry are verified
strengths.description: The authentication dependency pins RS256 and verifies expiration.

strengths.title: Database filters use parameter binding
strengths.description: Reviewed booking searches use SQLAlchemy expressions.

strengths.title: Baseline browser security headers are centralized
strengths.description: A middleware applies frame, content type, and referrer protections.

recommendations.title: Centralize tenant-scoped booking access
recommendations.details: Require organization_id in repository lookups and derive it only from the authenticated principal.

recommendations.title: Make production defaults fail closed
recommendations.details: Default debug mode to false and reject unsafe production combinations.

recommendations.title: Add regression checks for secure defaults
recommendations.details: Exercise configuration defaults in CI without loading real credentials.

limitations.title: No dynamic execution
limitations.details: Repository code was treated as untrusted and was not executed.

limitations.title: Limited repository history
limitations.details: Only a synthetic twelve-commit sample was available for history review.
